subject: physics
title: Power
key_idea: **Power** is the rate at which energy is transferred or work is done. Power equals energy transferred divided by time, or work done divided by time. One watt is one joule per second. A more powerful device transfers the same energy more quickly.

blocks.text: Power tells you how fast energy is transferred, not how much. This section covers the idea and the unit.

items.meaning: The rate at which energy is transferred, or the rate at which work is done.
The unit of power. 1 watt is an energy transfer of 1 joule per second (1 W = 1 J/s).

items: Two electric motors lift the same weight through the same height.
The motor that does it faster has the greater power.
Power is the rate of energy transfer or the rate of doing work.
A greater power transfers the same energy in less time.

worked_example.question:
